node.title: L1: below-band full-petal FPC5 residual payment
node.statement: At every official row and for every received word, after first-match assignment to one carried maximal sunflower source, the remaining full-petal contributors satisfying M>=4, d<ell(M-2), t<2M-4, and e=max(0,2d+1-t ell)->infinity admit one disjoint polynomial/profile allocation compatible with the imgfib reserve and quotient ledger. Here M is the number of source petals and t is the number touched by the contributor. This is exactly the FPC5 complement left after the proved top-band and E=0 root-pinning payments; mixed or partial petals are not part of this node.
node.attack_surface: pay the unbounded root-excess full-petal complement by the mu-basis/split-core-divisor, exact-shell Pade, or aggregate first-owner route without identifying source-petal count M with touched-petal count t
node.falsifier: a reserve-valid official-row family in FPC5 whose first-owner contribution exceeds every polynomial and every legitimate quotient/profile column
